character.name: Maelis

spells.name: Druidcraft
spells.description: You can create a minor sensory effect, predict weather, or make a small fire.

spells.name: Shape Water
spells.description: You can move or freeze water in a 5-foot cube.

spells.name: Fog Cloud
spells.description: You create a heavily obscured area of fog.

spells.name: Thunderwave
spells.description: A wave of thunderous force pushes creatures and deals 2d8 thunder damage.

traits: Sea-tongue: You can speak with aquatic creatures and understand their speech.
Stormborn: You have resistance to cold damage.
Lighthouse Keeper's Sight: You have advantage on Perception checks made in fog or darkness.
Drowned One's Resilience: Once per day, when you drop to 0 HP, you can instead drop to 1 HP and become stunned until the end of your next turn.
character.gear: Spear · Leather armor · Healing potion · Dried fish (2) · Hard bread (3) · Tidecaller's totem · Rope (50 ft) · Torch (2)
character.story: Born during a storm surge that shattered the lighthouse, Maelis was pulled from the sea by the keeper. The sea claimed her once, but gave her back with a whisper in her blood. She tends the light now, but every night she dreams of a city of drowned towers, calling her to the deep. She knows she will find it, and that the sea will ask for a price.

inventory.name: Spear
inventory.lore: A rusted spear from a sunken ship, its shaft carved with tidal runes. It hums faintly when the tide turns.

inventory.name: Leather armor
inventory.lore: Tanned from the hide of a sea serpent, it smells of salt and rain. The keeper wore it for thirty years.

inventory.name: Healing potion
inventory.lore: A vial of sea-foam and kelp, brewed by the tide witches. It mends wounds and clears the mind.
inventory.description: A small glass vial with a blue liquid

inventory.name: Dried fish
inventory.lore: Smoked herring, salted with tears of the sea. Sustains a sailor for a day.

inventory.name: Hard bread
inventory.lore: Stale, rock-hard bread from the keeper's pantry. It keeps for months and tastes of salt.

inventory.name: Tidecaller's totem
inventory.lore: A whalebone carved with the sigil of the drowned city. It acts as a druidic focus and resonates with the tide.
inventory.effects: Allows casting of druid spells without a pouch

inventory.name: Rope (50 ft)
inventory.lore: A length of rope from the lighthouse, frayed but strong. It has saved many lives in the storm.

inventory.name: Torch
inventory.lore: Pitch-soaked torches that burn even in the rain. The keeper always kept them ready.
